Storefront and customer routes of the shipping module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## POST /v1/shipping/rates

Calculate shipping rates

Request body: [CalculateRatesDto](#calculateratesdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Rates calculated.
- `400`: Invalid input.

## Schemas

### CalculateRatesDto

- `country` (string, min length 2, max length 2, required).
- `postalCode` (string, optional).
- `items` (array of [ShippingRateItemDto](#shippingrateitemdto), required).
- `subtotal` (number, min 0, required).

### ShippingRateItemDto

- `weight` (number, min 0, required).
- `quantity` (number, min 1, required).
